meaning:
πρό-δρομος, -ον
(προτρέχω) [in LXX: Num.13:21 (20), Isa.28:4 (בִּכּוּר), Wis.12:8 * ;]
running forward, going in advance. As subst., ὁ π., an advance guard, forerunner: Heb.6:20.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: where as a forerunner Jesus entered for us, having become a high priest forever after the order of Melchizedek.
